description: Phase 3 verification batch 2/3 — Channel B (CONTRADICTION+UNCERTAIN) keymgr

findings.title: op_ack_o 在 keymgr_op_state_ctrl 模块中未被驱动，而 keymgr_ctrl 逻辑期望该信号在合法条件下为高电平，造成功能缺失或不定态传播。所有依赖 op_ack 的控制路径（sw_binding_unlock_o、op_done_o、adv_state）均会出错。
findings.contradiction: op_ack_o 在 keymgr_op_state_ctrl 模块中未被驱动，而 keymgr_ctrl 逻辑期望该信号在合法条件下为高电平，造成功能缺失或不定态传播。所有依赖 op_ack 的控制路径（sw_binding_unlock_o、op_done_o、adv_state）均会出错。

evidence.excerpt: Outputs op_ack_o, op_busy_o, op_update_o, adv_en_o, and op_fsm_err_o are declared but not driven in this chunk.
sw_binding_unlock_o is asserted when adv_req=1, op_ack=1, and both op_err and op_fault_err are 0.
When op_req is asserted, op_done_o equals op_ack; otherwise op_done_o equals the logical OR of init_o and invalid_op.
adv_state is asserted when op_ack and adv_req are both high and op_err is low.

findings.title: edn_done 使用组合逻辑生成，未用寄存器同步，会产生毛刺，可能被下游时序逻辑误采样导致功能错误。
findings.contradiction: edn_done 使用组合逻辑生成，未用寄存器同步，会产生毛刺，可能被下游时序逻辑误采样导致功能错误。

evidence.excerpt: The timing and generation of edn_done must be verified: it must not be spuriously asserted during reset or before edn_req is set, and it must be synchronized to clk_i.
edn_done is driven to the logical AND of edn_req and edn_ack

findings.title: edn_done 的来源定义矛盾：上层协议假定其为外部可控制的脉冲信号，但实际 RTL 将其实现为内部组合逻辑输出，导致外部驱动无效，可能破坏握手时序或重新播种的完整性。
findings.contradiction: edn_done 的来源定义矛盾：上层协议假定其为外部可控制的脉冲信号，但实际 RTL 将其实现为内部组合逻辑输出，导致外部驱动无效，可能破坏握手时序或重新播种的完整性。

evidence.excerpt: edn_done is a synchronous pulse signal that can be sampled at the rising clock edge; its timing and duration are controlled externally.
reseed_done_o is continuously driven by edn_done
When edn_done is asserted, edn_req is cleared to '0, terminating the request.
edn_done is driven to the logical AND of edn_req and edn_ack

findings.title: init_i unintentionally affects init_q outside StSideloadReset, violating the intent that init_i be sampled only during reset. This can propagate unexpected state changes if init_i is erroneously asser
findings.contradiction: init_i unintentionally affects init_q outside StSideloadReset, violating the intent that init_i be sampled only during reset. This can propagate unexpected state changes if init_i is erroneously asserted.

evidence.excerpt: The init_i input is only examined in StSideloadReset and ignored in all other states. An unexpected assertion of init_i outside the Reset state does not cause any detectable effect, masking a potentia
In all other cases (no reset, not init_q&&!en_i, not init_i&&en_i), init_q retains its previous value.

formal.sva: assert property (@(posedge clk_i) disable iff (!rst_ni) (state_q != StSideloadReset) |-> (init_i |-> $stable(init_q)));

findings.title: 信号 valid_tracking_q 在设计中声明但未连接到任何驱动逻辑，导致其无法满足规范要求的异步/同步清零和值保持功能。这是一个严重的功能缺失。
findings.contradiction: 信号 valid_tracking_q 在设计中声明但未连接到任何驱动逻辑，导致其无法满足规范要求的异步/同步清零和值保持功能。这是一个严重的功能缺失。

evidence.excerpt: Signal valid_tracking_q is declared but not assigned or used in this continuous region; its purpose and connection are unclear.
When rst_ni is high and both slot_clr[i] and slot_sel[i] are deasserted, valid_tracking_q[i] retains its previous value.
When rst_ni is low, valid_tracking_q[i] is cleared to '0 asynchronously.
When rst_ni is high and slot_clr[i] is asserted, valid_tracking_q[i] is cleared to '0 synchronously on the next posedge clk_i.

findings.title: entropy_i 被硬连线为 0，与 keymgr_sideload_key_ctrl 对真随机熵的需求矛盾，将导致 PRNG 输出及 sideload key 更新完全可预测，严重破坏密钥生成的安全性。
findings.contradiction: entropy_i 被硬连线为 0，与 keymgr_sideload_key_ctrl 对真随机熵的需求矛盾，将导致 PRNG 输出及 sideload key 更新完全可预测，严重破坏密钥生成的安全性。

evidence.excerpt: entropy_i must be driven with true randomness during normal operation.
The LFSR's entropy_i input is permanently tied to '0; no external entropy is used.

findings.title: Debug invalid flags are only gated with specific operation enables (e.g., invalid_creator_seed.de only during adv_en & C
findings.contradiction: 假设描述了 debug 无效标志（如 invalid_creator_seed.de）仅在某些操作使能窗口（如 adv_en & Creator）被选通，因此窗口外的无效条件不会被捕获。提供的保证只覆盖了 stage_sel_o 的合法性检查和部分操作错误，没有涉及这些 debug 无效标志的捕获时机。无法确定设计预期是必须捕获所有时刻的无效条件（此时为覆盖缺口），还是允许窗口外丢弃无效条件（此时为防御性设计）。因此判断为不确定。

evidence.excerpt: Debug invalid flags are only gated with specific operation enables (e.g., invalid_creator_seed.de only during adv_en & Creator), so invalid conditions occurring outside these windows are not captured.

findings.contradiction: 该假设描述了 ctrl_rand 与 data_rand 均源自 LFSR 的假设性内部实现细节（可能的不对称性），但并未定义任何功能上的合法/非法输入或状态要求。现有的 guarantee 仅使用了 data_rand 的某些比特，不涉及它与 ctrl_rand 或 LFSR 内部结构的关系，因此无法证实或否定该不对称性是有意设计还是意外产物。假设本身为 uncertain，且无明确覆盖，因此判定为 UNCERTAIN。

findings.title: The padding data is a single random bit data_rand[0] replicated AdvLfsrCopies times. This may not provide sufficient ent
findings.contradiction: Assumption 表达的是对掩码随机性不足的担忧，属于设计质量评估而非一个可判定的合法/非法输入场景。Guarantee 描述了 data_rand[0] 的产生方式以及 id_matrix 的填充方式，与 assumption 中描绘的实现行为一致，但并未提供额外的熵保证来消除担忧。现有信息无法明确该担忧是否构成规约违反或缺口，因此保持 UNCERTAIN。

evidence.excerpt: The padding data is a single random bit data_rand[0] replicated AdvLfsrCopies times. This may not provide sufficient entropy for masking, especially if the bit is predictable or has low toggle rate.
data_rand[0] is lfsr[31:0] and data_rand[1] is perm_data(lfsr[63:32], RndCnstRandPerm).
For each i from KeyMgrStages to 2**StageWidth-1, id_matrix[i] is continuously assigned a vector of IdLfsrCopies bits, all equal to the current data_rand[0].
